<div class="dc-sheet-commentary"><div class="dc-sheet-rule"><h3>Natural logarithms</h3>
<p><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}\ln f(x)=\frac{f^{\prime}(x)}{f(x)}"></span></p><p>The printed rule already includes the chain rule.</p></div>
<div class="dc-sheet-rule"><h3>Other bases</h3><p><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}\log_a x=\frac1{x\ln a}"></span></p><p>The printed rule has an argument of <span data-math="x"></span> only.</p></div>
<div class="dc-sheet-generalisation fragment" data-fragment-index="0"><p>For a composite argument, apply the chain rule:</p><p><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}\log_a f(x)=\frac{f^{\prime}(x)}{f(x)\ln a}"></span></p><p class="small-note">Our extension: <span data-math="f(x)>0,\ a>0,\ a\ne1"></span>, with constant <span data-math="a"></span>.</p></div></div></div>
